capabilities: tag notes automatically based on their folder path
backfill folder tags across the entire vault
override or exclude tags for specific folders
choose tag style, word separator, and casing
keep or drop stale tags when notes move between folders
extras: Author states the plugin is 'entirely vibecoded' and self-tested only; it is also not reviewed by Obsidian staff, and installs via manual file copy rather than the plugin store.
problem: Obsidian derives no tags from where a note lives in the folder tree, so users must tag notes by hand to keep folder structure reflected in tags.
summary: Folder-based auto tagger that writes inline tags to notes from their folder path, stacking nested folder names into nested tags.
